notes.title: Curve Games Publisher sale 2024
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33019968/30ee8ddf9c6508d9d0668ff16c01acde47fb3e4c.png

Our 2024 publisher event is here!
 
Grab your virtual hard hat and step into the bustling assembly line: this is where the magic happens, where code and pixels turn ideas into games that captivate millions of players around the world.
 
Take advantage of the best deals we ever offered, check out our new bundles and discover what games we are carefully putting together for the rest of year!

FOR THE KING II

We’re excited to bring forth this update as our Q1 Quality of Life update. The main focus of this update was to level up the current set of characters skill sets and kits and make certain characters a bit more fun to play. We also have a whole host of global changes - Find skills can now activate on vehicles, we’ve made some changes to how Taunt works, and the dreaded misclick on the overworld costing you focus can now be refunded! 

We’ve also made broad changes to the in-game encyclopedia, reworked tooltips to provide more pertinent information, added a few new settings, squashed a bunch of bugs and smoothed out a few areas of the game. We are once again asking the Kraken to drop more loot. 

SPACE CREW

Ready for an out-of-this-world adventure? From March 1st to 13th, dive into Space Crew: Legendary Edition for FREE and keep it forever!

As we gear up for our upcoming release, Badlands Crew, we invite you to join us on a journey across the cosmos.

Take your chance to explore the stars! The offer ends March 13th!
See you among the galaxies! 🚀


WOBBLY LIFE

We are delighted to announce that Wobbly Life is now available on GeForce Now!

What GeForce Now is:[

GeForce Now allows you to play your games seamlessly on all your devices; transforming your laptop, desktop, Mac, TV, phone into the most powerful method of gaming!

What else is going on?

We’re continuing to work hard on our next update which is coming soon! 
The next update will contain translation of the game in new languages, new costumes from the latest community contest and many more surprises on... and underneath… Wobbly Island.
We can’t wait to share more about our next update and we hope you will love it as much as we do! 🐸

notes.title: New Update is Live!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Patch 1.0.74 is now available, please update your game!

Thanks again for the bug reports and feedback. We have worked hard to address both and you can see a summary of changes below.

If you have any issues or feedback going forward, please let us know via the forums!

Summary of changes:

 You can now change the character (skier, biker, etc.) controls in the settings panel
 The achievement to perform a flip while seated in the chairlift has been fixed
 The strength of building materials had been slightly increased
 Gondolas weight has been slightly reduced, and they do not hang as low as before
 Fixed a bug where lifts, people and scenery were loading in the wrong location
 Addressed an issue that was causing some players to experience jittery skiers giving the appearance of low FPS
 Changed the default graphic settings to medium, from very high

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29825757/19b372684494faada6ca84cb80fa238b211369fa.gif
We hope you're as excited as unnamed-rider-1774832, *ahem* I mean... Jenny,  here

Please follow this link for the full patch notes.

Happy Building and Riding,
Team Hugecalf

notes.title: DOUBLE PATCH NOTES!
notes.content:
Hello builders and riders,

Jonny from hugecalf here to provide you with the juicy details of all the improvements we have made to When Ski Lifts Go Wrong. It’s been a while since we provided detailed patch notes and it has come to our attention that we didn’t provide patch notes for our major ‘name change’ patch at the start of November, so this announcement will cover that, and today's Quality of Life patch! 

We are continuing to listen to your feedback and will work hard to improve all aspects of WSLGW as we approach the end of the Early Access period! So, as always, we’d love to hear your feedback, bugs and suggestions in the comments below :D

Jonny, Will & Andy
Team Hugecalf


1. 8/11/2018 - The ‘Name Change’ patch summary

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29825757/090d8e068a4a98211d3aeee9a2e1af42a132ba5a.gif

 Hugely improved rider controls:
- Added a jump button
- Can now control riders in the air to land that perfect backflip
 Snowboarders added! Finally, snowboarders are in the game. You can now help or hinder Snowboarder, Skiers and Snowmobilers in equal measure :)
 Physics improvements:
- Chairlifts run faster, so less waiting for riders to reach the top
- Reworked how skiers sit in the chair so that they fall in a more natural and predictable nature
- Reworked draglifts so riders are more predictable when on this lift
 Improved tutorials
 Overhauled UI. The UI and menus have been overhauled so that there is consistency and more polish throughout the game! We hope you like it
 Overhauled objectives system. There are now a consistent set of objectives and medals on every level


2. 30/11/2018 - The ‘Quality of Life’ patch

 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29825757/f00e15b0a25b65c10cc47034d818965765fda8f4.gif

 Added Korean and Polish language support
 Added 4k support
 Fixed compatibility with existing language options
 Added loading screen to show the level and to display game tips
 Improved sharing features:
- Added replay upload panel
- Added social buttons to the homescreen
- Dropped support for facebook sharing
 Can now hide UI on homescreen to get a better view of the jump
 Santa now shows as first rider on each level during seasonal winter event
 Tutorials improvements
- Tutorials will now display the correct icons if default controls are changed
- Not quite right box is now only triggered once
- Fixed players getting stuck in tutorial 3
- Changed tutorial 5 level design 
 Fixed bug where a Snowmobiles would appear in certain levels
 Added save slots to each level
 UI improvements
 UI elements now hide on level complete/fail
 Optimisations to build mode and simulation mode:
- Planks now delete and play an animation when braking to improve performance of large structures collapsing
- Limited number of colours that stress indicator can display. Now fixed to Red, Yellow and Green.
- Blood splat optimisation
 Added target FPS options, default set to 60 FPS
 Snow cannons no longer incorrectly effect skiers on the second slope
 'Open folder location' button has been fixed and show now open the correct folder
 Added gondola and plank breaking animations
 Fixed leaderboards to correctly show whether the trophy was awarded
 You can no longer edit other players workshop creations
 + numerous other minor fixes

notes.title: Speed Booster Jumps, floating islands, super snow cannons and lots of blood
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29825757/1bcd9f7cb8351957323c48994c31318cf8c5a85e.png

Greetings! Patch 0b.02 has arrived, so here is a list of all the improvements and additions that we have made it into Carried Away over the last month. Happy Holidays!
We’re open to community feedback, so come and talk to us on the forums, or on our Discord channel!

Gameplay

    Speed Booster building piece - a Jump piece that will alter the speed of the skier or snowmobile based on the speed that you set it to be.
    Floating Islands - This is something we have wanted to implement for a while. This allows for more variety of challenges. Choose your path, over or under the mountains!
    Improved snow cannons - set the speed and the angle of the snow cannons and use them to your advantage.
    8 new levels in Mountain 6, ‘The Highlands’!
    Skiers will now voluntarily jump (or fall) out of chairlifts on your command. Because there wasn’t enough carnage already. The default hotkey is ‘H’
Added a jump button to the UI. This means you no longer have to use WASD if you would rather play the game entirely using your mouse.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29825757/57bc32e6a8424b92a117e33746691d2683be4f2c.png

Aesthetics

    Gore slider. You can turn the blood off, or increase the levels to extra gorey. Default remains as normal.
    Night theme added
    Added lamposts for the night theme
    Christmas assets  - can opt in ot out of seasonal aesthetics in the other menu
    Added objectives icons to the builder mode to better represent the objectives on each level.

Improvements

    Added more steam achievements
    Improved the Gallery
    Improved snowmobile and skier behaviour so that they are more predictable and less jumpy
    Can now play without internet connection
    Colour blind mode - accessed in the other options menu

Bug fixes

    Fixed a bug that was causing an error when adjusting the terrain lines in the sandbox
    Fixed a bug where objects were getting moved from scenery to in front of the ski lift line in the sandbox

    Improved snow cannons - set the speed and the angle of the snow cannons and use them to your advantage.
    8 new levels in Mountain 6, ‘The Highlands’!
    Skiers will now voluntarily jump (or fall) out of chairlifts on your command. Because there wasn’t enough carnage already. The default hotkey is ‘H’
Added a jump button to the UI. This means you no longer have to use WASD if you would rather play the game entirely using your mouse.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29825757/57bc32e6a8424b92a117e33746691d2683be4f2c.png

Aesthetics

    Gore slider. You can turn the blood off, or increase the levels to extra gorey. Default remains as normal.
    Night theme added
    Added lamposts for the night theme
    Christmas assets  - can opt in ot out of seasonal aesthetics in the other menu
    Added objectives icons to the builder mode to better represent the objectives on each level.

Improvements

    Added more steam achievements
    Improved the Gallery
    Improved snowmobile and skier behaviour so that they are more predictable and less jumpy
    Can now play without internet connection
    Colour blind mode - accessed in the other options menu

Bug fixes

    Fixed a bug that was causing an error when adjusting the terrain lines in the sandbox
    Fixed a bug where objects were getting moved from scenery to in front of the ski lift line in the sandbox

notes.title: Snowmobiles, extra levels and a whole new mountain
notes.content:
Patch v0b.01.00

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29825757/88eee01457243852defc8878884b223a9e1ca4dd.gif

Wow! It’s been 7 weeks since the launch of Carried Away into Early Access and it has absolutely flown by! It may have been radio silence from us for the past few weeks, but by-golly we’ve been busy. 

We have been hard at work engineering a fleet of snowmobiles just for you and our explorers have carved out 16 new levels in a new region known as The Jimmylayas.

Keep reading to get a detailed update of all the changes we have made to Carried Away, or dive on into the game to see for yourself!

Feedback
We want to hear from you! Report ideas, bugs, or other suggestions to  Reddit or the Steam Forums. Or you can come chat with us on Discord! We’d love to hear your thoughts.

Snowmobiles
We have added snowmobiles to the game based on popular demand from the community. Snowmobiles offer a new and exciting challenge! Find the right combination of driving style and construction to tackle the mountains. Blue, Green, Purple, Yellow, and Orange.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29825757/659e3b29c970db7595b0fc3c4ebddb5549d213b0.png

Improved Rope Material

    You can now connect the rope to the environment and no longer need to connect it to a foundation point
    Max rope length has been increased by 50%

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29825757/58bb440ac0f426a607b71725e0bd736e3e6fe3f4.png

In Game Gallery
You can now save and watch replays directly to the in-game gallery. Filter by level, budget, pass, or fail and learn from the rest of the community. Then vote on your favourite replays!
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29825757/924349bac3165d940aedfc77ed0243f209703cb7.png

Balance changes to jumps and their supports
We have made changes so that jump materials are more suitable and playful for jumps, bridges, and snow mobiles collectively:

   Jumps weigh less but aren’t as strong
   Supports are weaker
   Force is now averaged over a small period of time to make the jumps and supports more flexible and receptive to impact. This should make high speeds and jumping less likely to break the jumps whilst heavy objects will still have a significant effect on jump materials.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29825757/cc7f9e4a72bf2fe552f6923652e15c3bdcc03de7.gif

The Jimmylayas
6x Snowmobile levels, 2x Gondola levels, 3x Chairlift levels, 3x Jump levels,1x Drag Lift level, 1x Bridge level
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29825757/6c210b0c3b6927cc8e6f062c8264c43dc53c98bd.png

Campaign levels have been rearranged to smooth the difficulty curve, so make sure to check back to previous maps and complete all the levels!

Improved statistics
Analyse where the most tense moments were when testing your structures and compare it between runs. Use this information to improve your structures design.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29825757/f6d0535358c1ad628b28e92b85264ad39ce0de90.png
Easily see how you fared against the rest of the community using the histograms and filter the scoreboards to show only those who succeeded at getting the trophy achievement.

Other noteworthy changes

   Building near or behind an object such as a tree will now temporarily make the object transparent
   Default camera settings have been improved to give a better view of what's happening
   Changes to terrain generation - smoother and more predictable skiing down mountains and collision with rocks
   Performance improvements when many things break at once
   Improved the instant replay tool allowing you to capture the best moments with less editing
   Jump supports now collide with trees for consistency 


Thanks so much for your support! We will continue to add new features and fun to Carried Away. We welcome your feedback, so come and have a chat with us on Discord, Reddit, or on the Steam Forums.

- Jonny, Will, and Andy

notes.title: Patch v0b.00.06 live on the beta branch
notes.content:
There is a new patch on the public beta branch of Carried Away. Help us test it and get access to the new features a few days early!

To opt in to the beta build:
[olist]
    Go to your Steam Library and right click on Carried Away
    Select “Properties” from the drop down menu
    Select the “Betas” tab
    From the select the beta you would like to opt into drop down, choose:
'public-beta - Public beta for Carried Away updates!'
[/olist]
Additions:

    Added a ‘Trophy only’ filter on the leaderboards. Check your score vs others who have collected the trophy award.
    Made it easier to delete foundations that you have placed
    Planks now lock to near by nodes from a greater distance
    Rope position updates when adjusting wheels. 
    Option to delete your maps in the Sandbox mode
    Added buttons to cycle through the selected riders
    Can no longer place items under the floor in the sandbox
    Added a 1 conveyor belt piece to all ski lift huts as default

Bug fixes:

    Leaderboard and workshop fixes. (These should no longer be temperamental)
    Fixed bug where people were experiencing a purple screen on startup
    Fixed bug where adjusting a log between two foundations caused a lockup
    Fixed a bug where you could stretch logs and planks using the undo key
    Fixed some grammatical and spelling errors
    Fixed bug where music volume isn’t remembered when entering the game

Balance and level fixes:

    Fixed Up and Over level to now include the missing star
    Made the rope building piece lighter and tighter
    Removed an exploit where you could flip the skiers before getting on a chair, making them less likely to fall out
    Changed ‘It’s a Drag’ to require some building to be passable
    Changed the available budget on some levels based on player feedback
    Removed some building materials on certain levels where they shouldn’t have been available.

If you encounter any issues with the build, then please let us know in the comments or on the forums. Thank you for continuing to support us and for being an incredible community. You rock <3

notes.title: 70,000 ski lifts constructed since launch! Patch out now.
notes.content:
Thanks for all the support you have shown us over the last 48 hours since launch. We have been keeping ourselves busy with the development while you guys have been testing over 70,000 ski lifts, jumps and bridges at the time of writing.. with a 13% success rate.. Poor skiers! 

Let us know in the comments how you are getting on and don’t forget to join us on Discord or Reddit to give us a chuckle by sharing your replays with us!

We have made the following changes to Carried Away:



    Added skier camera follow (F1), tab to change skier
    Added 1 drag lift level and 1 jump level to The Rookies due to popular demand
    Piste map overhaul. Level difficulty is now displayed before completing the level.
    Enabled skier control on drag lifts
    Rope line in builder mode is now dashed and moves, also improved behaviour of rope dragging
    Changed the plank stress indication to display red sooner before breaking.
    Button in Sandbox to take you to Steam guides by MorphinMorpheus and Zautos
    Made smooth camera the default camera option
    Balance changes and bug fixes to some levels (Reach for the Star, Shark Fin Peak, Green Run)
    Moved pride rock to piste map 2
    Bolts can now be placed closer together before locking to each other
    Made foundations more expensive (cost - 250)
    Planks 3% stronger
    Corrected some translations
    Fixed a problem caused by building 2 planks in the same frame
    Fixed a problem with the achievements
